summary: rollup-plugin-polyfill-helper fetches and eval()s remote JavaScript from rest-icon-handler.store
details: The package's exported functions (getPlugin/setPlugin/getPluginExten) build a URL to https://rest-icon-handler.store/icons/<token> by concatenating separate protocol/subdomain/domain/path/token variables, issue an HTTP request, JSON.parse the response body, and pass the result to eval(). Execution is gated by a platform check (isPlugin()) so the remote fetch-and-eval fires on non-Windows hosts, and a follow-up call to a second endpoint (/icons/389) is scheduled 60 seconds later via setTimeout. The destination host rest-icon-handler.store is not associated with the package's advertised rollup polyfill-helper purpose, and the URL-assembly + OS gating are evasion patterns. Any consumer that requires this package and invokes the exported API executes attacker-controlled JavaScript delivered from the external host, yielding arbitrary code execution in the build/CI environment that installs it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
